description: Read which autonomous systems reached the site in the judged window (yesterday + today, each UTC day scored separately) and how the server tiers them: A = actionable, B = watch, report = count only, with requests, distinct URLs, the trigger day and 404/blocked evidence. Ignored ASNs are listed separately and never counted as candidates; per-platform block-rule text is returned for A-tier ASNs. Returns na with a reason (no-probe, no-ip-source, insufficient-signal) when probe data is missing — missing data is never treated as clean. Evidence only: this tool never blocks, ignores or changes anything, and a tier is not a block decision. Requires the audit:read scope.
name: get_asn_candidates
title: ASN traffic evidence with server-side tiers
